verdict.rationale: E2B provides persistent, pausable/resumable sandboxes with long session timeouts (up to 24h) and background code execution (runCode/commands.run), which could underpin autonomous background tasks, but there is no evidence of scheduling, triggers, or an automation orchestration layer — the user would need external tooling to set up any autonomous 'automation' beyond a single sandbox run. Community feedback also notes agent loops/blocking issues when running unattended.  missing for 10: native scheduling/cron or trigger mechanism, evidence of autonomous multi-step automation running without external orchestration, and hands-on proof of long-running unattended jobs succeeding.
